description: One natural-language question in, one tool result out, deterministically: the router resolves the resort by name or nickname, picks an intent from the wording (snow, open/closed, forecast, cams, history, compare, where did it snow, percent of normal, profile, regions, alerts) and calls the matching tool. Returns the tool's data, the resort, citation URLs and a dated sentence to quote. Answers `answerable: false` with suggestions rather than guessing. No language model is involved.

question.description: The question as the user asked it, up to 300 characters, e.g. "is Alta open" or "where did it snow most in Colorado".

name: ask

answerable.description: False when the router found no resort or no intent it could serve; `data` is then null and `suggestions` says what to ask.

arguments.description: The arguments that tool was called with, so the call can be repeated over MCP.

asOf.description: ISO instant of the newest report the sentence used; null when it used none.

citations.description: PeakCam URLs to cite, the resort page first.

data.description: The tool's structured result (its documented `outputSchema`), or null.

resort.description: The resort the question named (the first, for a comparison).

resorts.description: Every resort the question named, in order.

sentence.description: A dated, source-labelled sentence that can be quoted verbatim.

suggestions.description: Questions the router can answer, offered when it could not answer this one.

tool.description: The PeakCam MCP tool whose result is in `data`.

title: Ask PeakCam
